answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique acoustic beacon keyed to a shared LBL clock at dawn, so duplicate pseudonyms collide in the same ranging epoch. Validators cross-correlate SAS beamformed returns against an opal-coded pilot tone, and only agents whose Doppler dead-reckoning track matches a distinct lotus-seeded position hash accrue. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
